set.body:
Source: plan phase 3; review findings with no prior bead.

Problem:
A typed failure ADT is flattened to a string and then re-parsed, in a codebase that is otherwise rigorous about ADTs.

- agent/SchedulerRequestHandler.scala puts failure.toString on the wire for both DomainFailure and ProtocolFailure, discarding the AgentFailure ADT so the client cannot recover the typed failure.
- ssh/SshAgentWireClient.scala tags failure kinds by prefixing strings ("remote-cli:", "remote-agent:", "protocol:") and re-parsing them with startsWith and stripPrefix. It is not currently miscategorizing anything, because the prefix is always at position zero and checked in order, but it is fragile and reads as string stuffing.

Acceptance:
- Replace the prefix dance with a small local ADT.
- Carry enough typed structure across the wire that the client can reconstruct the failure kind rather than a rendered string; treat any wire shape change as a codec decision under P6f.12.

Related to P6f.8 (keep SSH process failures inside the typed outcome algebra).
set.title: P7.5: Keep transport and agent failures typed to the boundary
